_TEMPLATE: UNATTESTED — a control CATALOGUE, not a claim. Each entry names a control this platform is designed around and maps it to a framework; `operated: null` means nobody has confirmed it runs in THIS deployment. Several are pure process (backup restore tests, on-call paging, code review on merges) that no code can satisfy. Publishing this as-is asserts an operating control program to customers and auditors that may not exist. The operator MUST set `operated` true/false per control from evidence, then set attested=true with a name and date.
_comment: Cross-references to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / NIST CSF kept short for vendor questionnaires. `shipped` describes what the generated code provides; `operated` is the operator's attestation and is the only field a customer should be shown.

controls.name: MFA available for admin users (enforcement is an operator policy)
TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest
Secrets in env vars / KMS, never in code
Append-only audit log for security events
Dependency and secret scanning in CI
Automated daily backups, restore tested quarterly
Customer notification within 72h of confirmed breach
Code review required on all merges
